_comment: The newest SHIPPED version, per platform. `web` is stamped automatically at build by scripts/stamp-version.mjs and must not be hand-edited. `ios` and `android` are bumped BY HAND, and only when a release is actually live in the store: the web deploys the moment main is pushed, while the stores lag behind review and staged rollout, so one shared number would tell an iPhone that a version still in App Review is out.
